review.basis: Independent SECOND_PASS solve: DKA management in Current D8 spans KP09 and KP10—fluid resuscitation is the key first treatment, normal serum K with urine output >40 mL/h still requires potassium replacement, and bicarbonate is reserved for severe acidosis (Study pH <=6.9). Because the official A/C/D answer spans both KPs, Block-level D8 is the smallest safe Primary.
